template: bucket(zscore(rank(winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4))), range="-3,3,0.5")
idea: 采用分桶操作（bucket）将连续信号离散化为多档，基于排名分位数的zscore进行非线性分段，实现“极强/强/中/弱/极弱”的阶梯式仓位配置。
